'''Deckland Carper''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] who joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] after [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan's]] [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was ultimately [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Thune (bounty hunter)|Thune]]. His droid, [[U-THR]], was also taken by Thune.
